records.title: Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper as the only build tool

acceptanceCriteria.text: `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` names `gradle-8.14.3-bin.zip` as its distribution, and the repository contains no `pom.xml`, `build.xml`, `mvnw` or other non-Gradle build tool file. [D-001]

records.requirement: The system shall be built only through the Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper, and the repository shall contain no Maven or other build tool files.
records.rationale: Covers D-001. Same Gradle version as TinyHttpd for includeBuild alignment.

records.title: Module set and root project name

acceptanceCriteria.text: `settings.gradle` includes exactly nine modules: `NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-servlet`, `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, `NaruServe` (bootstrap), `NaruServe-kotlin`, and the SLF4J, rotating file and Logcat `Logger` modules, each logger module name starting with `NaruServe-`. [D-002]
`settings.gradle` sets `rootProject.name = 'NaruServe-build'`, so no two projects of the composite build share the coordinate `com.snoworca.naruserve:NaruServe`. [W2-001]
The default bootstrap module that backs `RestApp.create()` is the project named `NaruServe`. [D-002; wave decision: root project name]

records.requirement: The system shall, in the root `settings.gradle`, name the root project `NaruServe-build` and include `NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-servlet` and one module each for the TinyHttpd `HttpAdapter`, the Gson `JsonCodec`, the default bootstrap backing `RestApp.create()`, the Kotlin extensions, the SLF4J `Logger` adapter, the rotating file `Logger` and the Logcat `Logger`.
records.rationale:
Covers D-002 and the loop W wave decisions: root project rename to NaruServe-build (W2-001, supports D-002, D-008, D-364) and bootstrap module name `NaruServe`. The exact suffixes of the three logger modules are not fixed by the design; the concrete choice is made during implementation (C-07) within the `NaruServe-` prefix constraint.
- [2026-10-19] The names `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, `NaruServe` and `NaruServe-kotlin` adopt the #1 proposal quoted in D-002.

records.title: Single root build file configures every module

acceptanceCriteria.text: The root `build.gradle` holds the plugin, compile, dependency and check configuration of every included module. [D-003]
No module directory of the root build contains a `build.gradle` or `build.gradle.kts` file. [D-004]

traceLinks.notes: Root build file configures the module set

records.requirement: The system shall configure every module of the root build from the root `build.gradle`, with no per-module build file.

records.title: Java 8 bytecode target for Java and Kotlin compilation

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every `JavaCompile` task of every module is configured with `options.release = 8`, and the produced main and test classes have class file major version 52. [D-006]
Every Kotlin compile task of every module, main and test source sets alike, is configured with `jvmTarget = 1.8`, and the produced Kotlin classes have class file major version 52. [D-007]

On JDK 17, the Kotlin Gradle Plugin's JVM-target consistency check between each Kotlin compile task and its Java compilation at `options.release = 8` passes, and `./gradlew build` reports no Inconsistent JVM-target error. [D-006, D-007]

traceLinks.notes: Compile targets set in the root build file

records.requirement: The system shall compile Java sources of every module with `options.release = 8` and Kotlin sources of every module and test source set with `jvmTarget = 1.8`.
records.rationale: Covers D-006, D-007. Java 8 bytecode is required by object.md §1.2 for Android 5.0 (API 21) compatibility.
records.implementationNotes: - AC-3 states the outcome only. One way to reach it is to set Java `sourceCompatibility` and `targetCompatibility` to `1.8` next to `options.release = 8`, so the Kotlin Gradle Plugin's JVM-target check sees target 1.8; the mechanism is an implementation choice (C-07).

records.title: Maven group and Java package root

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every module of the root build has Maven group `com.snoworca.naruserve`, and every class of every module's main source set is declared in package `com.snoworca.naruserve` or a subpackage of it; a test source set may additionally declare a test-scope stand-in for a platform class, such as the fake `android.util.Log` class of D-403. [D-008, D-403]

records.requirement: The system shall use one Maven group and one Java package root, fixed in issue #1 as `com.snoworca.naruserve`, for every module.
records.rationale: Covers D-008. The temporary value `com.snoworca.naruserve` of the design is fixed as final for issue #1.

records.title: Main dependencies of every module declared in wave 1

acceptanceCriteria.text: In this requirement a main dependency is an `api`, `implementation` or `runtimeOnly` declaration; `compileOnly` declarations are covered by AC-2. Wave 1's root `build.gradle` declares, per module, exactly these main dependencies: `NaruServe-api` none; `NaruServe-servlet` `NaruServe-api`; `NaruServe-tinyhttpd` `NaruServe-api`, `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core`, `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-websocket`; `NaruServe-gson` `NaruServe-api`, `com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0`; `NaruServe` (bootstrap) `NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, the Logcat `Logger` module; `NaruServe-kotlin` `NaruServe-api`, `org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib`; the SLF4J `Logger` module `NaruServe-api`, `org.slf4j:slf4j-api:1.7.36`; the rotating file `Logger` module `NaruServe-api`; the Logcat `Logger` module `NaruServe-api`. [D-005, D-010, D-011, D-016, D-228, D-384, D-386]

Wave 1's root `build.gradle` declares, as `compileOnly` dependencies, the chosen compileOnly nullability library of CON-BUILD-011 for every module, plus `javax.servlet:javax.servlet-api:3.1.0` and `javax.websocket:javax.websocket-api:1.1` for `NaruServe-servlet`, and no other `compileOnly` dependency. [D-012, D-026]
The `runtimeClasspath` of `NaruServe-api` contains no artifact. [D-009]

The Gson module declares `com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0` as its only external main (`api`, `implementation`, `runtimeOnly`) dependency besides `NaruServe-api`; the chosen compileOnly nullability library of CON-BUILD-011 is not a main dependency. [D-010]
`NaruServe-servlet` declares `javax.servlet:javax.servlet-api:3.1.0` and `javax.websocket:javax.websocket-api:1.1` in `compileOnly` only, and neither appears on its `runtimeClasspath`. [D-012]

The SLF4J adapter module declares `org.slf4j:slf4j-api:1.7.36` as its only main (`api`, `implementation`, `runtimeOnly`) dependency besides `NaruServe-api`; the chosen compileOnly nullability library of CON-BUILD-011 is not a main dependency. [D-384]
The bootstrap module `NaruServe` declares a main dependency on the Logcat `Logger` module. [D-386]

Wave 1's root `build.gradle` applies the `java-test-fixtures` plugin to `NaruServe-api`, so `NaruServe-api` has a `testFixtures` source set before the wave that adds the D-108 in-memory `HttpAdapter`. [D-005, D-108]

`NaruServe-gson` declares `com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0` in the `api` configuration, so `com.google.gson.Gson` is on the main `compileClasspath` of the bootstrap module `NaruServe` and of any caller that depends on `NaruServe-gson`, without a direct gson edge in the bootstrap. [D-196, D-197, D-228]

traceLinks.notes: Dependencies are declared per module of the module set
Dependencies are declared in the root build file

records.requirement: The system shall declare in wave 1 the complete main and compileOnly dependency set of every module, so later waves add only test-scope dependencies or the release plugins owned by issue #18.
records.rationale: Covers D-005, D-009, D-010, D-011, D-012, D-016, D-026, D-228, D-384, D-386. Gson is pinned at 2.14.0 because 2.15+ needs API 24. The nullability library stays an implementer choice (C-07) and appears here as "the chosen compileOnly nullability library".
records.implementationNotes:
- The D-005 clause that later waves add only test-scope dependencies or the #18 release plugins is not a wave-1 AC; it is checked at run-end verification against the AC-1/AC-2 graph.
- Whether each `NaruServe-api` edge is `api` or `implementation` is an implementation choice (C-07), except two edges: TinyHttpd, which CON-BUILD-009 AC-4 fixes to `implementation`, and `NaruServe-gson` -> `com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0`, which AC-9 fixes to `api` because `GsonJsonCodec` takes a caller-built `Gson` and the bootstrap builds the default STRICT `Gson` (D-196, D-197, D-228).
- [2026-10-19] Wave 1 applies the `java-test-fixtures` plugin to `NaruServe-api` (AC-8), so the D-108 in-memory `HttpAdapter` fixtures of a later wave need no build-plugin change, and the run-end D-005 check sees no new plugin. Dependencies that later waves add to the `testFixtures` configurations count as test scope under D-005.

records.title: kotlin-stdlib confined to the Kotlin extension module

acceptanceCriteria.text: `kotlin-stdlib` is on the `runtimeClasspath` of the Kotlin extension module, and in every other module it is absent from the `api`, `implementation`, `compileOnly` and `runtimeOnly` declarations and from the main `compileClasspath` and `runtimeClasspath`; test configurations and the Kotlin Gradle Plugin's own tool configurations (such as `kotlinCompilerClasspath` and `kotlinBuildToolsApiClasspath`) are not checked. [D-011]
`gradle.properties` sets `kotlin.stdlib.default.dependency=false`. [D-387]

A build check that runs as part of `./gradlew build` fails, naming the module, when a module other than the Kotlin extension module has `kotlin-stdlib` on its `runtimeClasspath`, and passes on the wave 1 dependency set. [D-388]

traceLinks.notes: stdlib check runs over the declared dependency set

records.requirement: The system shall keep `kotlin-stdlib` off the main configurations of every module except the Kotlin extension module, and shall fail the build when any other module has `kotlin-stdlib` on its `runtimeClasspath`.
records.rationale: Covers D-011, D-387, D-388. object.md §12 and CLAUDE.md forbid a Core dependency on the Kotlin stdlib.

records.title: Logcat Logger module builds without an Android SDK

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Logcat `Logger` module declares no Android SDK, `android.jar` or Android artifact on any compile configuration, its main source set contains no compile-time reference to an `android.*` type, and it compiles and runs its tests in the root build without an Android SDK; the test-scope fake `android.util.Log` class of D-403 in its test source set is allowed. [D-385, D-403]

records.requirement: The system shall build the Logcat `Logger` module with no compile-time Android dependency, reaching `android.util.Log` only through reflection at runtime.

records.title: TinyHttpd dependency boundaries

acceptanceCriteria.text: The TinyHttpd adapter module declares TinyHttpd as `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core` and `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-websocket` coordinates, and Gradle resolves them to the included TinyHttpd projects, with no `project(...)` or file reference to TinyHttpd. [D-016]
No module other than the TinyHttpd adapter module declares a dependency on any `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd` artifact. [D-017]
No module declares a dependency on `tinyhttpd-router` or `tinyhttpd-session`, and neither appears on any module's `runtimeClasspath`. [D-018]
The TinyHttpd adapter module declares the TinyHttpd artifacts in `implementation` scope, never `api`, so no TinyHttpd artifact is on the `compileClasspath` of any other module. [W2-006]

traceLinks.notes: Coordinates substitute the included TinyHttpd build
TinyHttpd is part of the adapter module's declared main dependencies

records.requirement: The system shall reference TinyHttpd only from the TinyHttpd adapter module, only through the Maven coordinates `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core` and `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-websocket`, and only in `implementation` scope.
records.rationale: Covers D-016, D-017, D-018 and wave decision W2-006 (implementation scope, supports D-017, D-209).

records.title: TinyHttpd checkout stays read-only

acceptanceCriteria.text: `git status --porcelain` run in the TinyHttpd checkout reports no modified, added or deleted tracked file after the wave 1 build, and no wave 1 commit touches a file inside the TinyHttpd checkout. [D-019]
Each TinyHttpd gap found during wave 1 is recorded as a deferred issue of the run, and no wave 1 commit contains a patch to TinyHttpd sources for it. [D-020]

traceLinks.notes: Read-only use of the included TinyHttpd checkout
Read-only TinyHttpd and deferred-issue rule fixed in #1

records.requirement: The system shall leave every file inside the TinyHttpd checkout unmodified in every wave of the run, and shall record a TinyHttpd gap that the NaruServe adapter cannot fill as a deferred issue.
records.rationale: Covers D-019, D-020 and the integration check I-006 (TinyHttpd shows no modified files). Answers committee Q-2 (TinyHttpd is read-only).
records.implementationNotes: - The ACs cover wave 1's own build and commits only. The end-of-run state (I-006: TinyHttpd shows no modified files at the end of the run) is checked at run-end verification, not by wave-1 evidence.

records.title: compileOnly nullability annotations recognised by Kotlin

acceptanceCriteria.text: One nullability annotation library is declared `compileOnly` for every module of the root build and is absent from every module's `runtimeClasspath`. [D-026]

A Kotlin compile fixture that calls a Java method annotated with the library's `@Nullable` fails to compile `val s: String = annotatedNullable()`, and the same fixture compiles `val t: String = annotatedNonNull()` for a method annotated with its `@NonNull`, showing that Kotlin sees nullable / non-null types rather than a platform type `T!`. [D-026]

traceLinks.notes: compileOnly annotation dependency is part of the wave 1 dependency set

records.requirement: The system shall add in wave 1 one nullability annotation library that the Kotlin compiler recognises, declared in `compileOnly` scope with no runtime dependency.
records.rationale: Covers D-026 (object.md §12, CLAUDE.md Kotlin compatibility). Which library is used is not fixed by the design; the concrete choice is made during implementation (C-07) and must satisfy: recognised by the Kotlin compiler, compileOnly, no runtime dependency, usable under the API 21 check.

records.title: animal-sniffer API 21 check on Android-bound modules

acceptanceCriteria.text: `./gradlew check` runs the animal-sniffer `android-api-level-21` check on the main source sets of `NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, `NaruServe`, `NaruServe-kotlin`, the Logcat `Logger` module and the rotating file `Logger` module, and a main class there that references an API absent from API 21 fails the check. [D-027]
`NaruServe-servlet` has no animal-sniffer task, and `./gradlew check` runs none for it. [D-028]

traceLinks.notes: Check targets are modules of the module set

records.requirement: The system shall run animal-sniffer with the `android-api-level-21` signature on the main source set of every Android-bound module as part of `check`, and shall not apply it to `NaruServe-servlet`.
records.rationale: Covers D-027, D-028. Mirrors the TinyHttpd animal-sniffer setup (plugin 2.0.1, signature `android-api-level-21`). The SLF4J adapter module is not in the D-027 list.

records.title: Core isolation, servlet-free Android modules and single Gson version build checks

acceptanceCriteria.text: An automated check that runs as part of `./gradlew build` fails when a main class (main source set output) of `NaruServe-api` references `android.*`, `javax.servlet.*`, `jakarta.servlet.*`, `com.google.gson.*`, `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd.*` or `kotlin.*`, and passes on the wave 1 sources; test classes of `NaruServe-api` are not inspected. [I-002]

An automated check that runs as part of `./gradlew build` fails when the resolved dependency graph of any module selects a `com.google.code.gson:gson` version other than 2.14.0, and passes on the wave 1 dependency set. [I-005]

An automated check that runs as part of `./gradlew build` fails when a main class (main source set output) of any Android-targeted module (`NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, `NaruServe`, `NaruServe-kotlin`, the Logcat `Logger` module and the rotating file `Logger` module, as listed in D-027) references `javax.servlet.*`, and passes on the wave 1 sources. [I-004]

traceLinks.notes: Checks run over the declared dependency set

changeNotes.reason: Restore the SRS-MD §30.2 draft heading marker that the iter-1 title edit dropped

records.requirement: The system shall fail the build when `NaruServe-api` main classes reference a forbidden package, when main classes of an Android-targeted module reference `javax.servlet`, and when dependency resolution of any module selects a Gson version other than 2.14.0.
records.rationale: Covers integration items I-002, I-004 and I-005 as automated checks introduced in wave 1 (loop W addition). The Android-targeted modules of I-004 are the seven D-027 API 21 check targets. Only main classes are inspected, so Kotlin tests in `NaruServe-api` (T11 / smoke, OPS-BUILD-002 AC-3) do not trip the I-002 check. The Android sample part of I-005 is checked from the wave that adds the sample.

records.title: TinyHttpd composite build through a Gradle property

acceptanceCriteria.text: `settings.gradle` calls `includeBuild` on the directory read from a Gradle property, and `settings.gradle` itself supplies the default `/Users/beom/work/git/TinyHttpd` when the property is unset; `gradle.properties` or the command line only override that default. [D-013]
The `includeBuild` path is not a hard-coded relative path, so `./gradlew build` run from a git worktree of this repository resolves the same TinyHttpd checkout. [D-014]

When the configured directory does not exist, `./gradlew build` fails before any task runs, while Gradle evaluates `settings.gradle`, with a message that names the property and the path it tried. [D-015]

records.requirement: The system shall include TinyHttpd into the build with `includeBuild`, reading the checkout directory from a Gradle property whose default is `/Users/beom/work/git/TinyHttpd`, and shall fail while Gradle evaluates `settings.gradle` when that directory is missing.
records.rationale: Covers D-013, D-014, D-015. Answers committee Q-1 (composite build through a Gradle property). Wave decision W2-004 (shared TinyHttpd build output, serial waves) adds no build requirement: serial orchestration is recorded in §3 Assumptions and the read-only rule stays in CON-BUILD-010.

records.title: Test tooling and the root build gate

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the nine modules of CON-BUILD-002 AC-1 (`NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-servlet`, `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, `NaruServe`, `NaruServe-kotlin`, and the SLF4J, rotating file and Logcat `Logger` modules) declares `junit:junit:4.13.2` as its test framework dependency. [D-022]
The root `build.gradle` applies a Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.x version, and Kotlin test sources compile and run in `./gradlew build`. [D-023]
`./gradlew build` executes one Java smoke test and one Kotlin smoke test, and the test reports show both as passed. [D-024]
`./gradlew build` exits with status 0 on JDK 17 with no `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` or `local.properties` `sdk.dir` set. [D-025]

Wave 1's root `build.gradle` applies the Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.x with `jvmTarget = 1.8` to all nine modules of CON-BUILD-002 AC-1, so the Kotlin tests that later waves add under D-349, D-351 and D-355 need no build-plugin change; with `kotlin.stdlib.default.dependency=false` (CON-BUILD-007 AC-2) this adds no `kotlin-stdlib` to the main configurations of any module other than the Kotlin extension module. [D-005, D-023, D-349, D-351, D-355]

traceLinks.notes: Test tooling configured in the root build file

records.requirement: The system shall run JUnit 4.13.2 Java tests and Kotlin tests compiled by Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.x inside the root `./gradlew build`, including one Java and one Kotlin smoke test, and the build shall pass on JDK 17 without an Android SDK.
records.rationale: Covers D-022, D-023, D-024, D-025. The wave 1 gate is the root `./gradlew build` with one Java and one Kotlin smoke test (issue #1).

records.title: Module names and coordinates in docs/api and CLAUDE.md

acceptanceCriteria.text: A file under `docs/` or `CLAUDE.md` names the TinyHttpd commit the run builds against (46b973e); which file is an implementation choice (C-07). [D-021]

`docs/api/README.md`, `docs/api/app.md`, `docs/api/json.md`, `docs/api/kotlin.md` and `docs/api/logging.md` name the final module names and dependency coordinates, and none of them contains a (미확정) marker for a module name or dependency coordinate. [D-029]
The module line of `CLAUDE.md` lists all nine modules, marks the seven D-027 modules as API 21 check targets and marks `NaruServe-servlet` JVM-only. [D-448]
Neither `CLAUDE.md` nor `docs/api/kotlin.md` contains the provisional name `rest-kotlin`; both use the final Kotlin module name. [W2-005]
The `jakarta` module marker in `docs/api/servlet.md` is unchanged by wave 1. [W2-003]

traceLinks.notes: Docs name the final module set
CLAUDE.md marks the API 21 check targets

records.requirement: The system shall name, in `docs/api/` and `CLAUDE.md`, the final module names, dependency coordinates, API 21 check targets and the TinyHttpd commit fixed in issue #1.
records.rationale: Covers D-021, D-029, D-448 and wave decisions W2-005 (rest-kotlin replacement) and W2-003 (servlet jakarta marker stays for wave 8 under D-358).
